SOP-002: Password Reset and Account Lockout > Repeated Lockouts
Repeated lockouts within a day usually mean an old password is cached on a phone (Outlook/Teams mobile) or a mapped drive. Ask the user to update the password on all devices. If lockouts continue, escalate to IAM (L2) to check the lockout source in the domain controller logs.

DEV-001: Internal GenAI Platform Access and API Keys (synthetic analogue) > Quotas and Errors
- Default dev quota: 200,000 tokens per day per project. A 429 error means the quota is used up; it resets at 00:00 UTC.
- Quota increases are requested by the project lead with the expected daily volume.
- A 401 error usually means an expired key: dev keys expire every 90 days.

SOP-002: Password Reset and Account Lockout > Security Note
If the user did not trigger the lockout themselves, treat it as a possible attack: priority P1, route to the Security Operations Centre (SOC).

SOP-002: Password Reset and Account Lockout > Overview
Owner: Identity & Access Management | Applies to: Active Directory / Entra ID accounts
